candidateAudit.text: "Vienna" is a song by British new wave band Ultravox, released on 9 January 1981 by Chrysalis Records as the third single and the title track from their fourth studio album of the same name (1980). The new wave ballad, which features Midge Ure on lead vocals, is regarded as a staple of the synth-pop genre that was popularised in the early 1980s, and remains both the band's signature song and their most commercially successful release.

candidateAudit.text: Wiens längstes Straßenfest verbindet Generationen! 🎈✨ Das Josefstädter Straßenfest steht vor der Tür – und heuer feiern wir unter einem ganz besonderen Stern: Ein Fest für alle Generationen! candidateAudit.text: This is not your annual “you live in Austria, therefore you MUST speak German” lecture. Fuck that. You don’t need to prove you deserve to live here. You don’t need to become Austrian. And nobody should be checking your grammatical gender before letting you belong. This is a selfish recommendation from one Not Born Here person to another: Learn the language because you get more Vienna. More jokes. More conversations. More independence. More weird little interactions. More chances for people here to actually know you. Bad German counts. Slow German counts. German delivered with an accent so aggressive it needs its own Meldezettel counts. Just start speaking. Turn the subtitles off and see what happens. Send this to the person who has been saying “I really need to learn German” since 2021.

candidateAudit.title: Wusstest du, dass der Mann hinter „Bunbury – Ernst sein ist alles" einer der schlagfertigsten Köpfe der Literaturgeschichte war? 🎭 Oscar Wilde, geboren 1854 in Dublin, war Dichter
candidateAudit.text: Wusstest du, dass der Mann hinter „Bunbury – Ernst sein ist alles" einer der schlagfertigsten Köpfe der Literaturgeschichte war? 🎭 Oscar Wilde, geboren 1854 in Dublin, war Dichter, Dramatiker und ein Meister der Pointe. Sein wohl berühmtester Satz bringt es auf den Punkt: „Ich kann allem widerstehen, außer der Versuchung." Genau dieser Witz steckt auch in „Bunbury": Zwei Dandys, ein erfundener Freund namens Bunbury, ein erfundener Bruder namens Ernst und ein Chaos aus Lügen, Liebe und gesellschaftlichem Schein, das bis heute zum Lachen bringt. Die Komödie gilt bis heute als eines der witzigsten Theaterstücke überhaupt – gerade live zu erleben beim Sommertheater Mödling vor der Kulisse von St. Othmar. Bei uns gibt's die Tickets dafür zum Sonderpreis. 🎟️ Link in der Bio #modling #sommertheater #rundumwien

candidateAudit.text: 12 Desserts you must try in Vienna: ☕️1. Sachertorte - The famous, rich chocolate cake with apricot jam. 📸__megd.meals 👑 2. Kaiserschmarrn - Shredded fluffy pancakes with plan sauce 🥧3. Buchteln - Soft, fluffy, pull-apart sweet yeast buns. They are typically filled with jam and served with vanilla sauce 🥮4. Salzburger Nockerl - The iconic, ultra-light Austrian soufflé dessert that originates from the city of Salzburg. it deflates incredibly fast and must be served immediately straight from the oven. 📽️ mustafahelvaci 🎶5. Mozart Torte - The luxurious Austrian cake inspired by the famous Mozartkugeln (Mozart balls) - the iconic chocolate, marzipan, and pistachio truffles. 📸 sorinakb 🍰6. Erdbeer-Kardinalschnitte - soft biscuit sponge and crisp meringue, sandwiched around a rich strawberry and whipped cream filling. happy_enchanted 🍑7. Topfenknödel - Austrian curd cheese dumpling. It is essentially the direct, versatile sibling to the Marillenknödel (with peach inside) but without the fruit hidden inside. 🍧8. Scheiterhaufen - traditional Austrian bread pudding designed to use up stale bread. Scheiterhaufen is hearty enough to be served hot as a sweet main course for lunch. It is often served with a side of vanilla sauce or a cold berry compote. 📽️ pianoyuan 🧁9. Punschkrapferl (or Punschkrapfen) is a classic, bite-sized Austrian rum cake that looks like a pink cube. It is a staple of Viennese pastry shops, closely resembling a French petit four. 📸 sunset.2lov cafeschwarzenberg 🍎10.
